gloss: black and white; right and wrong

definitions.explanation: The combination of the colors black and white. Used to describe photographs, films, or images without color.

definitions.gloss: right and wrong, guilt or innocence
definitions.explanation: A figurative use meaning the distinction between right and wrong, or whether something is true or false. Often used in the phrase {白黒|しろくろ}をつける (to settle/determine).

examples.japanese: {白黒|しろくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白黒|しろくろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This film was shot in black and white.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{白黒|しろくろ}⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: An old black-and-white TV still remains at my grandparents' house.

examples.japanese: {白黒|しろくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけよう→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's settle this once and for all.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白黒|しろくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to determine right and wrong on this issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{白黒|しろくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきりする→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I can't say anything until the trial makes things clear.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is used as a noun modifier: {白黒|しろくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (black-and-white photo), {白黒|しろくろ}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (black-and-white film). Note the order is "white-black" in Japanese, opposite to English "black and white."

For sense 2, the key phrase is {白黒|しろくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to settle/determine guilt or innocence). ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ represents innocence and ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ represents guilt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白黒|しろくろ}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: black-and-white photo
- {白黒|しろくろ}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: black-and-white film
- {白黒|しろくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to determine right or wrong
- {白黒|しろくろ}⟦はっきりさせる→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧: to make things black and white (clear)
